[h1]Post Release Patch v1.1 and 20% discount![/h1]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Shift Happens
notes.content:
Shift Happens is Now Available on Steam!

Shift Happens is a cooperative platformer for two. You and a friend shift your mass, throw each other and puzzle your way through four stages of stylized imaginary worlds. Including the occasional backstabbing and taunting. Play with a friend on a couch, online or even special singleplayer levels.

notes.title: Release: February 22nd! Finally making Shift Happen!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/announcement_full_release_date/header_img.png[/IMG]
[h1]Release![/h1]
I can't believe I am actually writing these words but we have a final release date for Shift Happens:
[b]February 22nd[/b], which is roughly one week after Valentines Day. 

We couldn't be happier about it! Therefore I'd like to point out again that we are [b]very grateful[/b] for everyone that supported us by either [b]buying[/b] the game in Early Access, giving us [b]feedback[/b], writing a [b]review[/b] or simply telling us that they [b]like[/b] it. 
Considering that Shift Happens most certainly wasn't an ideal type of game for an Early Access title (linear playthrough, depending on lots of content, very co-op), we still think it was good to put it out there and have the players take a look. We also learned a lot by going through the process and will take that experience into consideration for future projects.
We hope you are as excited as we are and are looking forward to the 22nd.

[h1]Livestream today[/h1]
We will also have a livestream @ CET 7pm with [url=https://twitter.com/minnalya]Nora, our character artist[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/Klonkimon]Simon our Shader/FX and 3D Art guy[/url] today on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/klonkgames]twitch[/url] creating some new hats for the game.

Cheers,

Team of Klonk

notes.title: A long overdue update! Release Info and more
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/announcement_overdue_update/header_img.png[/IMG]
Hey girls and boy! First off, I owe you all an apology:
It has been so very quiet around the forums and the launch of Shift Happens and I am sorry for that!
For everyone that was wondering why the game still hasn't launched yet, I will try to clarify and give an insight into what's happening @Klonk Games lately.
Although we thought the launch would be this july we had to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/359840/announcements/detail/886465109803511254]delay[/url] it to an - even for us - unknown date. 
This was back in August, pre-gamescom and now it is November already. During this time a lot has happened for us, especially when it comes to marketing the game.

[h1]Timing is everything[/h1]
That said, our initial plan was to release Shift Happens on steam this july together with the XBOX One version simultaneously.
Now, speaking from a marketing point of view as a small developer, everybody you talk to regarding this issue will tell you that timing your launch means "everything". Simply said, your release date will have a big impact on how your game will eventually sell. Obviously there's a lot more to it than just the release date but it plays an important role anyways. Most importantly, releasing an indie game in Q4 (sept to december) is always a higher risk because around this time all the bigger companies are announcing and releasing their triple A titles. So chances are very low for your game to get picked up by press and therefore won’t get much attention or any at all. Of course, there might be exceptions but exceptions prove the rule, right?

With this in mind, we had lots of discussions and came to the conclusion that, since we didn't manage to get everything perfectly done for a launch in early august, we would have to delay the release even further. 

[h1]Why no patches/updates[/h1]
Now you might obviously ask: "Well, if you had to delay the launch, why hasn't there been an update/patch on steam?"
One reason is staying alive. As mentioned a lot of times, we are constantly doing contract works to make ends meet and still be able to develop Shift Happens.
The other reason for this is that we had to switch yet again to a newer version of the engine we use, which is Unity 3D. From a game dev's point of view, having to switch to a newer version of your engine sometimes can mean re-doing a whole lot of work. In our case it meant playtesting (looking for old/new bugs) and lightbaking EVERYTHING again. Lightbaking is a procedure that takes a long time and a lot effort. Very simply put, lightbaking takes real time lighting from a scene and "bakes" it onto your objects so they look illuminated. This process comes with a lot of issues/bugs itself which means setting it up with parameters that work is a walk on a tightrope itself. Now having to re-do this with an updated lightbaking process means re-setting every parameter again to ensure the game looks still like before the engine update. That alone took us 2 months. Which brings me to my last point:

[h1]This patch/update[/h1]
We have currently finalized light baking processes and bugs that came with the update of Unity. This patch is a bigger one due to the re-done lightmaps and will include a few bugfixes as well, but mostly minor things.

[h1]Full Release date and content[/h1]
With all that explained, we are aiming for a [b]simlaunch for early 2017[/b] Q1 where we will launch on every platform Steam, XBOX One and PS4.
The full release will still feature the current game including:
[list]
[*]the 4th and last stage of the game, The Grotto! (10+1 Bonuslevel in multiplayer and 7+1 bonuslevel in singleplayer) 
[*]The story cutscenes, explaining Bismo and Plom's connection 
[*]Bug fixes.
[/list]

I'd also like to encourage everyone to give feedback or ask questions if there are any!

Other than that I will make sure to update you more consistently on what is happening or if anything has changed for the release of the game. Believe me when I say there's nothing more that we want than to finally release our baby "Shift Happens”

Cheers,

Team of Klonk

[IMG]http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/bugfixes_sound_&_improvements_01/header_img.png[/IMG]

Hello everybody,

Long time no hear, sorry for that. I can just say we are still working very hard on the game and since we are a small team that really sweats blood and tears to make a living out of game dev, we also have to do other stuff (contract work) in order to stay alive financially.That said, we come with a an update that brings you great fixes and a little bit of polish.

Contentwise, it is important to note that the full content (the last stage "grotto" and cutscenes with story) will be released with the full release.
Unfortunately we can't tell you when exactly the full release will be but it might take around 1-3 months.

Anyways, this update brings a lot of small fixes and hopefully bigger ones for those of you that had issues playing the game.
So lets start of with whats new:

[list]
[*] Added timerun clocks and a message when you first unlock a timerun by completing a level
[*] The main and pause menu got a visual update and now have different colored buttons depending on the current stage 
[*] A lot of sounds got added including voice overs for Bismo and Plom
[*] The winscreen got music jingles and cool sound effects
[*] All levels now got (updated) ambience sounds
[/list]

[IMG]http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/bugfixes_sound_&_improvements_01/timerun.gif[/IMG]

[h1]FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

[b]Netcode:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bonus object sometimes not being sync
[*] Fixed some asyncs with lifting/dropping. Also made lifting look smoother on client
[*] Synced up lives more
[*] Added waiting screen when waiting for connected partner to load a level
[*] Fixed worldmap sometimes not being sync
[*] Fixed pushing/pulling with two players being async
[*] Fixed pushing/pulling sometimes blocking levers
[/list]

[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented the player from getting lifted
[*] Show current amount of lives more clearly at start of level
[*] Fixed helping planes show false buttons after disconnect a joystick

[*] Fixed achievement progress being wrong

[*] Many small sound improvements

[*] Fixed timer circle display being offset

[*] Fixed pause menu disappearing a bit too early when closing

Team of Klonk

notes.title: Build 151222 - Content Update #5
notes.content:
[IMG]http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/05_content_update_18_12_2015/header_img.png[/IMG]

Christmas is going to be earlier than expected... at least for Bismo and Plom!
First of all, Team Klonk wishes everyone of you [b]Merry Shift-Mass and a Happy New Year![/b]
 
The past few weeks/month have been very stressfull and busy for us. To be honest, we have been whippin' our asses off to get everything done and create a new content update for the holidays...
and we really did it! 
We are very happy to finally be able to have some vacation and bring you some brand new content for the holidays to play with your partner, friend, parents, spouse, husband, dog and cat!

The biggest change with this update is the worldmap! With the worldmap you finally can see your [b]level progress[/b], [b]collect stars[/b] and [b]unlock bonuslevels[/b]. We even added time stars for each level!

Due to the rather light feedback on the game in general escpecially on our "challenge levels" we decided to remove them, since they were just some experimental levels.

Remember that you can always check out what's planned for the future of [b]Shift Happens[/b] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/359840/discussions/0/517142253855432096]here![/url]

[h1]CONTENT[/h1]

[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the Worldmap incl. cool names for each level!
[*] Added Winmachine in the Winroom for more fanciness!
[IMG]http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/05_content_update_18_12_2015/winroom.png[/IMG]
[*] Added 4 new Splashscreen incl. teaser for our last stage [b]the grotto[/b]
[IMG]http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/05_content_update_18_12_2015/splashscreens.png[/IMG]
[*] Added a new animated UI for coins[IMG]http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/05_content_update_18_12_2015/ui_3.gif[/IMG]
[*] Added a new Infoscreen in the pausemenu
[IMG]http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/05_content_update_18_12_2015/pausescreen.png[/IMG]
[IMG]http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/05_content_update_18_12_2015/pausescreen_2.png[/IMG]
[*] Added 21 New Achievements!
[/list]

[b]Singleplayer:[/b]
[list] 
[*] Following levels now have graphics: canyon04, canyon05, canyon06
[*] Added two new bonus levels: lab_bonus and canyon_bonus
[/list]

[IMG]http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/05_content_update_18_12_2015/ui.png[/IMG]
[IMG]http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/05_content_update_18_12_2015/ui_2.png[/IMG]

[b]Multiplayer:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added two new bonus levels: lab_bonus and canyon_bonus
[/list]

[IMG]http://www.shifthappensgame.com/images/steam/05_content_update_18_12_2015/ui_multiplayer.png[/IMG]


[h1]FIXES[/h1]
While our coders were not only busy porting the game, they have also been fixing bugs, improving the game and adding the content:

[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Screen Transitions + Loadingscreen
[*] New Input System allowing for more controllers to be used
[*] Added black bars for unsupported resolutions
[*] Added info messages for some events
[*] Fixed small visual bug with lasers
[*] Fixed catchign a falling player being harder than intended
[*] Fixed impulse plattforms using sideways impacts
[*] Fixed corner-case preventing progression in test chambers
[*] Fixed scales clipping through stuff
[*] several stability fixes
[*] Added toastmessages for connecting/disconnecting controllers
[*] Added new tooltips for the loading screen
[*] Added and updated some localisation files. At the moment there are: EN, DE, RU and FR. 
[/list]

[b]Menu:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed several bugs that occured with different inputs
[/list]


We hope you have fun with the freshly added content and we would love to hear some feedback! 
Especially for the new content, which we tried to test and bugfix as much as possible.

[h1]Know ISSUES[/h1]
Unfortunately we have two bugs that occur [b]only[/b] in online multiplayer but couldn't fix yet so in case they appear, you have to restart the game. 
So here go the two know bugs:

- If one of the party member leaves the game via menu, the other is stuck in either the loading or splash intro screen. In this case you have to ALT-F4 out of the game and kill the process.
- In the elevator only the host sees the worldmap. During this time the client can't move and do anything. We will change this in the future but it'll take more time to do so, thats why its in this state right now!

I hope you have fun!

Stay tuned,

Team Klonk

notes.title: Shift Happens in Early Access
notes.content:
[b]BUILD 150909[/b]

Hi everyone!

For quite a while now we’ve been working hard on the development of Shift Happens. The time has finally come and we’re proud to provide you with this experience we’ve been polishing with all of our care!

Since the game is mainly designed around a co-op experience, we included a good deal of multiplayer levels, including an early online- and local co-op prototype. Of course we didn’t forget about our solo players: You can access our whole first singleplayer stage and one of the challenge levels.  Please keep in mind that this is the first of many Early Access builds and content is still subject to change.  It might include bugs or work-in-progress content.

Now without further ado, we present you the whole list and wish you a lot of fun.

[h1]CONTENT[/h1]

Supported Modes:
[list]
[*]Local co-op
[*]Online co-op (Beta)
[*]Singleplayer
[/list]

Fully finished levels:
[list]
[*]Singleplayer Lab Levels 1-13
[*]Multiplayer Lab Levels 1-13
[*]Multiplayer Forest Levels 1-3
[*]Multiplayer Canyon Levels 1-3
[/list]

Levels without Art + WIP Sound:
[list]
[*]Singleplayer Forest Levels 1-2
[*]Singleplayer Challenge-Level 1 (Labyrinth)
[*]Multiplayer Forest Levels 4-5
[*]Multiplayer Canyon Levels 4-5
[*]Multiplayer Challenge-Levels 1-2 (Coin-Arena + Lift)
[/list]

[h1]NOTES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Please keep in mind you need at least one controller for local multiplayer mode on a single pc. We support XInput devices (e.g. Xbox One or Xbox 360 Controller).
[*]Having to resart a level in order to finish it is never intended. If you feel like you’re in a deadlock due an unintended way of solving a puzzle (or due to a bug) please report this! We require and encourage your feedback in order to improve the game.
[/list]

[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]
General:
[list]
[*]Pushing/pulling huge crate is sometimes impossible. Shifting should fix this.
[*]German and Russian translations are not fully complete, yet
[*]Challenge Levels: due to Single Shift there may occur a bug with crate interaction. Shifting should fix the issue for now.
[/list]

Online Co-Op:  Various bugs and lags due to it being in an early testing state
[list]
[*]“Invite Friend” button remains highlighted, even after successful invite (just a visual bug)
[*]Various interactions (between players and/or interactive objects) may be lagging or lead to permanent lags (visual bug). Shifting might solve this issue.
[*]Sometimes players have different sizes on different machines. Suiciding or killing the affected player once, shifting or restarting the level might fix the issue for now. If not, you have to re-establish the connection.
[*]Spamming inputs on levers and pressure plates might lead to differences between connected clients
[*]If the network connection failed to establish properly it might fail all consecutive times as well. In that case please restart the game on both of your machines.
[/list]

Since the game is mainly designed around a co-op experience, we included a good deal of multiplayer levels, including an early online- and local co-op prototype. Of course we didn’t forget about our solo players: You can access our whole first singleplayer stage and one of the challenge levels.  Please keep in mind that this is the first of many Early Access builds and content is still subject to change.  It might include bugs or work-in-progress content.

Now without further ado, we present you the whole list and wish you a lot of fun.

[h1]CONTENT[/h1]

Supported Modes:
[list]
[*]Local co-op
[*]Online co-op (Beta)
[*]Singleplayer
[/list]

Fully finished levels:
[list]
[*]Singleplayer Lab Levels 1-13
[*]Multiplayer Lab Levels 1-13
[*]Multiplayer Forest Levels 1-3
[*]Multiplayer Canyon Levels 1-3
[/list]

Levels without Art + WIP Sound:
[list]
[*]Singleplayer Forest Levels 1-2
[*]Singleplayer Challenge-Level 1 (Labyrinth)
[*]Multiplayer Forest Levels 4-5
[*]Multiplayer Canyon Levels 4-5
[*]Multiplayer Challenge-Levels 1-2 (Coin-Arena + Lift)
[/list]

[h1]NOTES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Please keep in mind you need at least one controller for local multiplayer mode on a single pc. We support XInput devices (e.g. Xbox One or Xbox 360 Controller).
[*]Having to resart a level in order to finish it is never intended. If you feel like you’re in a deadlock due an unintended way of solving a puzzle (or due to a bug) please report this! We require and encourage your feedback in order to improve the game.
[/list]

[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]
General:
[list]
[*]Pushing/pulling huge crate is sometimes impossible. Shifting should fix this.
[*]German and Russian translations are not fully complete, yet
[*]Challenge Levels: due to Single Shift there may occur a bug with crate interaction. Shifting should fix the issue for now.
[/list]

Online Co-Op:  Various bugs and lags due to it being in an early testing state
[list]
[*]“Invite Friend” button remains highlighted, even after successful invite (just a visual bug)
[*]Various interactions (between players and/or interactive objects) may be lagging or lead to permanent lags (visual bug). Shifting might solve this issue.
[*]Sometimes players have different sizes on different machines. Suiciding or killing the affected player once, shifting or restarting the level might fix the issue for now. If not, you have to re-establish the connection.
[*]Spamming inputs on levers and pressure plates might lead to differences between connected clients
[*]If the network connection failed to establish properly it might fail all consecutive times as well. In that case please restart the game on both of your machines.
[/list]
